{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Absentia Natural Park |image=Absentia Natural Park.png |characters=アルサス自然公園 |japanese=Alssace Natural Park |imagesize=250px |region=Unova |colorscheme=Unova2 |epicode=M16 |episode=Genesect and the Legend Awakened }} '''Absentia Natural Park''' (Japanese: '''アルサス自然公園''' ''Alssace Natural Park'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Unova]], which appeared in ''[[M16|Genesect and the Legend Awakened]]''. It is known as '''Alssace Nature Park''' in the English-language version of the [[Genesect and the Legend Awakened (manga)|manga adaptation]]. The [[Genesect Army]]'s personal connection to the Panna Lotus flowers originally attracted them to [[New Tork City]]'s [[Pokémon Hills]]. [[Eric]] later explained that he transplanted the 300 million-year-old flowers to Pokémon Hills from Absentia Natural Park. In the end, {{Ash}}, {{ashfr}}, and Eric drove to the location and helped the Genesect Army relocate to the park due to their attachment to the Panna Lotuses. Absentia Natural Park is a water-filled canyon surrounded by pine forests.
